uk.s: Promotion period: November 16, 2026–December 12, 2026, held in three phases

Rewards will be distributed to the Bitget accounts of eligible winners. The specific distribution time and related arrangements will be subject to the official winner announcement and final promotion rules.
From 2026-11-11 00:00 (UTC) to 2026-11-30 23:59 (UTC), eligible users who hold at least 0.01 USDe for 24 hours can enjoy up to 10% APR rewards, including exclusive Bonus Tiered APR of 4.75%.
Real-Time APR (Approximately 2.3%) + 8% Bonus Tiered APR (Tier 0 - 1,000 USDT)
Real-Time APR (Approximately 5.4%) + 10% Bonus Tiered APR (Tier 0 - 100,000 KGST)
Real-Time APR (Approximately 1.2%) + 0.1% Bonus Tiered APR (Tier 0 - 0.2 ETH)
⏳ Last 2 Days of My Stock Trading Experience sharing! 👀
Share your real experience with Bitget U.S. Stock products, including rToken and Stock Perps. Tell us what you love, share your trading insights, and suggest what we can improve!
Your Voice, Our Products. Become a Bitget Community Product Officer and help shape better products!
A 3000 USDT promotion pool is waiting for you! Three phases, 1000 USDT per phase, and 165 winners in total.
Your voice deserves to be heard!
Share your Bitget product experience, help drive product improvements with fans around the world, and get a chance to share 3000 USDT in rewards!
Use the following hashtags on X:

All Bitget users can join the Bitget Product Fan Club as Community Product Officers in accordance with the promotion requirements and share original product experience content during the relevant promotion period.
What counts as successful participation in the promotion?

Participants must publish original product experience content on X that aligns with the current phase's theme. Posts must include the following two promotion hashtags: #BitgetCommunityProductOfficer #BitgetFans. After publishing, submit your Bitget UID, X post link, and participation phase through the designated promotion form to complete your entry submission.
What types of content can I submit?

Participants may submit screenshots of product operations, feature reviews, product walkthrough videos, text-and-image experience reports, and specific product improvement suggestions. All content must be based on genuine product experience and align with the theme of the current promotion.

Official selections will be based on factors including content originality, depth of product experience, value of feature reviews, constructive feedback, and community engagement. We place greater value on authentic product experience sharing that offers useful insights, rather than simply reach or engagement metrics.
When will the winner list be announced?

Content requirements: Share your genuine product experience, feature reviews, or optimization suggestions on X based on the designated Bitget product theme for the current phase. Content must be original.
Add hashtags: Your post must include both #BitgetCommunityProductOfficer and #BitgetFans.
Submit your entry: Submit your X post link and Bitget UID through the official promotion form to complete your participation.
Winner selection: Bitget will select winning entries based on originality, depth of experience, practical value, and engagement.
